# Solana Launch Tape

Clean, daily data files about what happens when new Solana meme coins launch and graduate: every trade, who is behind each launch, other launchpads, and Meteora pool metrics. Recorded 24/7 by our own recorders since early October 2026.

## The datasets

| Dataset | What it is | Rows a day (Oct 10 2026) | Since |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gradtrades` | Every buy and sell on PumpSwap in the first 30 minutes after each pump.fun graduation, with wallet, amounts, price, pool reserves and fees | ~5,034,000 | Oct 3 2026 |
| `pregrad` | Who is behind each pump.fun launch: creator, its funding, curve buyers, graduation-slot buyers, the cap path; plus a +10 min price outcome. Raw facts only | ~194,000 | Oct 4 2026 |
| `padfeed` | Graduations on Meteora DBC (Bags, Jupiter Studio...) and Raydium LaunchLab (bonk.fun): migration facts, pool balances every few seconds, top holders, quote prices in US$ | ~32,500 | Oct 3 2026 |
| `meteora-pools` | Per-minute price, TVL, volume and exact per-minute fees for ~200 Meteora DLMM pools | ~287,000 | Oct 6 2026 |

**History is short and honest:** the oldest files are from October 3 2026, and it grows by one day every day. Coverage gaps (a dropped connection, a coin skipped under our data budget) are written into the files as rows (`down`, `up`, `resume`, `end` with `why`), never filled in or guessed.

## How it is collected

- Only public sources: Solana's public RPC, PumpPortal's free public feed, Meteora's public API, Jupiter's free price API.
- Nothing private: no keys, no logins, no scraped profiles or social handles.
- No wallet labels: we sell what happened on chain (addresses, amounts, times). We do not sell our own opinions on wallets ("insider", "rugger" and the like). Those fields are removed before export.
- Our own trading wallets are removed from every file.
- Every line is parsed and checked before it ships; malformed rows are dropped.

## Files and update cadence

- One gzipped JSON-lines file per dataset per UTC day: `gradtrades-YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl.gz`, `pregrad-...`, `padfeed-...`, `meteora-pools-...`.
- A new day is ready daily, after the UTC day closes.
- Read them with anything: `zcat file.jsonl.gz | jq`, pandas `read_json(..., lines=True)`, DuckDB `read_json_auto`.

## Free sample

A 2-hour cut of every dataset, 2026-10-10 14:00-16:00 UTC (`site/sample/`). Full days, history and the daily feed are paid (see Pricing).

## Schemas

### gradtrades schema

One JSON object per line. Every row has `type` and `t` (ms since 1970 UTC, when our recorder received it). SOL amounts in SOL, token amounts in whole tokens (6 decimals). Source: Solana public RPC (PumpSwap program logs), first 30 minutes after each pump.fun graduation.

| type | field | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| grad | t | number | graduation time (ms; chain block time for late pick-ups) |
| grad | bt | number | block time (s) |
| grad | slot / sig | number / string | slot and signature of the graduation (migration) transaction |
| grad | mint | string | the coin's token mint |
| grad | pool | string | its PumpSwap pool |
| grad | coinCreator | string | wallet that receives the coin's creator fees |
| grad | poolBase / poolQuote | number | starting tokens / SOL in the pool |
| grad | virtualQuote | number | PumpSwap's extra virtual SOL in the price math (~17.6 SOL, Oct 2026) |
| grad | price | number | SOL per token at graduation |
| grad | capSol | number | price x 1e9 (market cap in SOL, ~496 for a normal graduate) |
| grad | curveSol | number | SOL raised by the bonding curve |
| grad | late | bool | picked up late; trades before `followFrom` are missing |
| grad | followFrom | number | ms; trades are complete from here on |
| grad | follow | bool | false = coin not followed (cap outside 300-600 SOL, or found too late) |
| trade | bt, slot, sig, i | number, number, string, number | block time (s), slot, signature, index of the PumpSwap trade inside the transaction |
| trade | mint | string | coin |
| trade | side | "buy" / "sell" | direction |
| trade | user | string | wallet that traded |
| trade | baseAmount | number | tokens bought or sold |
| trade | quoteAmount | number | SOL paid (buy, fees included) or received (sell, after fees) |
| trade | price | number | quoteAmount / baseAmount (effective price, fees included) |
| trade | poolBase / poolQuote | number | pool tokens / real SOL after the trade |
| trade | priceAfter | number | pool price after the trade: (poolQuote + virtualQuote) / poolBase |
| trade | virtualQuote | number | only when the pool's virtual SOL changes (rare) |
| trade | userTokensBefore | number | the wallet's balance of this coin just before the trade |
| trade | lpFee / protocolFee / creatorFee | number | fees in SOL |
| trade | creator | bool | true when the trader is the coin's creator |
| trade | ix | string | instruction variant, e.g. `buy_exact_quote_in`; absent for a normal buy |
| trade | recovered | bool | the log was truncated; trade read from the full transaction |
| end | mint, why, buys, sells | string, string, number, number | coin no longer followed: `window` (30 min done), `evicted` (cap of 30 coins), `budget` (data budget); counts recorded |
| down / up | t | number | a feed connection dropped / came back: trades in between may be missing |
| resume | mint | string | coin picked up again after a restart; the gap before `t` is missing |

Failed transactions are not included. Coverage gaps are marked, never filled in.

### pregrad schema

Who is behind each pump.fun launch, as raw facts (addresses, amounts, times). No wallet labels, no risk flags, no images. Sources: PumpPortal free websocket (creations, migrations), Solana public RPC (bonding curves, transactions). Amounts in SOL; `pct` = % of the 1,000,000,000 supply; times in ms unless the name ends in `S` (seconds).

| type | field | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| create | t, mint, sig | number, string, string | coin creation |
| create | creator | string | creator wallet |
| create | name, sym | string | coin name / ticker |
| create | devTokens, devSol | number | creator's own buy at creation |
| create | capSol | number | curve market cap right after creation |
| create | curve | string | bonding-curve account |
| create | mayhem | bool | pump.fun "mayhem mode" launch |
| curvex | slot, curve, mint | number, string, string/null | bonding-curve cap crossing (mint null when not yet mapped) |
| curvex | cap, cross, sol, sinceFirstS | number | cap now (SOL), line crossed (100/200/300/400 SOL), SOL in curve, seconds since first seen |
| ctrade | bt, slot, sig, i, mint, side, user | | bonding-curve trade on a coin near graduation (read from cap 200 SOL up) |
| ctrade | sol, tokens, capAfter, curveSol | number | SOL and tokens of the trade, cap and curve SOL after it |
| migrate | mint, sig, pool | string | migration seen by PumpPortal (`pool` = destination AMM) |
| grad | mint, slot, capSol, creator | | graduation as seen on chain |
| record | mint, sym, name, pool, slot0, sig0, t0, bt0 | | one per graduate, written 10-40 s after graduation (t0 = graduation) |
| record | src | object | which feed saw it first; `curveCompleteS` = curve completed how long before t0 |
| record | creator, create | string, object | creator wallet; creation tx (`t`, `sig`, `mayhem`, `capSol`) |
| record | ageS | number | creation to graduation, seconds |
| record | instant | bool | graduated within 5 s of creation |
| record | cap0, curveSol | number | PumpSwap cap at graduation; SOL raised |
| record | devBuyTokens, devBuyPct, devBuySol | number | creator's buy at creation |
| record | creatorPctAtGrad | number/null | creator's holding at graduation |
| record | creatorInfo | object | `txs50` (tx count, capped 50), `capped`, `oldestS`, `nBefore10m`, `funder`, `fundSol`, `fundedBeforeS`, `fundMemo`, `priorCoins24h`, `priorCoins72h` |
| record | gradSlot | object/null | PumpSwap buys in the graduation slot: `pct`, `sol`, `nWallets`, `nTx`, `buys[]` (`w`, `tokens`, `pct`, `sol`, `sig`, `bundleSize`, `payer`, `signers`, `slotOffset`, `creatorInTx`), `whale` = the largest of those buys with its wallet facts (`txs25`, `oldestS`, `lastTxKind`, `funder`, `fundSol`, `fundedBeforeS`, `fundSig`, `fundMemo`, `gainers[]`) |
| record | curve | object | `coverage` (full/partial/none), `holders[]` (top 10: `w`, `pct`, `sol`, `creator`), `creationSlot`, `bundleEst`, `estimated`, `top1NcPct`, `top5NcPct`, `nOver3Pct`, `bundleWallets`, `bundlePct`, `creatorPct`, `path` (`t100S`..`t400S`, `maxCap`, `updates`, `completeS`), `trades` |
| outcome | mint, sym, t0, recT | | +10 min after graduation |
| outcome | capAt | object | PumpSwap cap (SOL) at +10/45/60/120/180/300/600 s |
| outcome | maxGain, minDrop | number | best / worst move in %, first 10 min |
| outcome | crashed | bool | fell by 80%+ |
| outcome | trades | number | PumpSwap trades counted |
| outcome | dump, firstBigSell, bigSells[] | object | the first sale breaking a fixed size rule and the large sales: `tS`, `w`, `frac` (share of pool sold), `sol`, `capAfter`, `rule`, `tokensFrom` |
| outcome | src | string | where trades were read from |

Removed before sale: our internal "rogue" wallet list and every field derived from it, `flags`, `priorRugged`, the dumper `role`, picture fingerprints and metadata URIs, heartbeat/stats rows.

### padfeed schema

Graduations on two non-pump.fun Solana launchpads: `dbc` = Meteora Dynamic Bonding Curve (Bags, Jupiter Studio, ...) -> DAMM v2 pool, `ray` = Raydium LaunchLab (bonk.fun etc.) -> Raydium CPMM pool. Each coin followed 20 min (dbc) / 30 min (ray). Source: Solana RPC; US$ quote prices from Jupiter's free price API.

| type | field | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| all | t | number | ms when recorded |
| grad | pad | "dbc"/"ray" | launchpad |
| grad | platform | string | platform config / name |
| grad | mint, quote | string | coin mint; quote mint (SOL, or a token such as USD1/a tokenized stock) |
| grad | pool, curveAuth, baseVault, quoteVault | string/null | pool and vault accounts |
| grad | b, q | number | vault balances (tokens, quote units) at migration |
| grad | px | number | price in quote = q / b |
| grad | supply, decimals, tokenProgram | number, number, string | mint facts (Token or Token-2022) |
| grad | feeBps, freeze, mintAuth | | Token-2022 transfer fee, freeze / mint authorities (null = none) |
| grad | sig, bt / other | | migration signature, block time and when heard |
| px | pad, mint, b, q | | vault balances when they changed (every ~6 s, ~2 s for fast-moving coins); price = q / b |
| holders | pad, mint, top10, top20[] | | +60 s and +5 min: 20 largest token accounts (`acct`, `owner`, `amt`); `top10` = share held by top 10 excluding pool vaults and curve |
| qpx | usd | object | every 30 s: US$ price of SOL and of every non-SOL quote mint seen in the last 2 h, keyed by mint |

### meteora-pools schema

One row per pool per minute, Meteora DLMM pools with TVL >= US$50k, top 200 by 24h fee/TVL. Source: Meteora's public DLMM API (dlmm.datapi.meteora.ag). No RPC, no wallets.

| field | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| type | "pool" | row type |
| t | number | ms when fetched |
| pool | string | DLMM pool address |
| price | number | pool's current price (quote per base token, as Meteora reports it) |
| tvlUsd | number | total value locked, US$ |
| vol24hUsd | number | rolling 24 h volume, US$ |
| fees24hUsd | number | rolling 24 h fees, US$ |
| vol24hDeltaUsd | number/null | change in the rolling 24 h volume since the pool's previous row |
| feesMinUsd | number/null | exact fees earned since the previous row (diff of Meteora's all-time cumulative fees); null on a pool's first row or a reset |

Token mints and names are not in the row; look them up from the pool address (Meteora API or chain).
